cod.en: Over thirteen hundred deaths in just seven months. That's what cholera did in the Congo in 2025. And it starts with the water people drink.
cod.fr: Plus de mille trois cents morts en seulement sept mois. Voilà ce que le choléra a fait au Congo en deux mille vingt-cinq. Et tout commence par l'eau que l'on boit.

eth.en: Over twenty-seven thousand cholera cases in a single year. In Ethiopia, the outbreak has lasted since 2023. And it starts with the water people drink.

nga.en: In 2024, three in every hundred people who caught cholera in Nigeria died. And it often starts with water that looks perfectly clean.
